'''Red's Conkeldurr''' (Japanese: '''レッドのローブシン''' ''Red's Roubushin'') is a Pokémon {{PPM|Red}} {{pkmn2|caught}} in the [[Unova]] [[region]].

==History==
===PMBW series===
Conkeldurr first appeared in ''[[PMBW14|The New Member is an Architect!!]]''.

In ''[[PMBW31|Meeting Again! Champion Green!!]]'', Conkeldurr meets {{PPM|Green}} and his {{TP|Green|Charizard}} for the first time.

===PMXY series===
Conkeldurr made a cameo in [[PMXY01]].

==Personality and characteristics==
Even though Conkeldurr's strengths are unknown, he has a similar personality as Red's Pokémon.

==Trivia==
* Conkeldurr is the only main walking Pokémon of Red's who was not shown using any moves.
